title: Common local frames for normalized symmetric Proj pullback
statement: Let g : X → S be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme] and E a quasi-coherent module with quasi-coherent tensor pullback g*E [pqf-def-coherent, def-pc-module-pullback]. Form the relative symmetric Proj spaces of E and g*E [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra, def-nagata-relative-proj], and fix normalized tautological quotients D and D′ [def-per-projective-bundle-quotient-data]. Let b be coefficientwise graded pullback data preserving all degree-one inclusion generators [def-nagata-graded-algebra-pullback-data], with relative Proj map j [prop-nagata-relative-proj-functoriality]. On the source T of j put P=j*D.line, Q=D′.line and M=(p∘j)*E. Let q:M→P be the pulled quotient after the normalized pullback-composition isomorphism, and let q′:M→Q be D′.quotient after equality transport e and the other normalized composition. There exist a small open cover (U_i) of T and free generators s_i of P on U_i and t_i of Q on U_i such that: for every V⊆U_i∩U_j and a,c∈Γ(V,O_T), the relation a s_i|V=c s_j|V implies a t_i|V=c t_j|V; and for every V⊆U_i and m∈Γ(V,M), some c∈Γ(V,O_T) satisfies q(m)=c s_i|V and q′(m)=c t_i|V. The assertion supplies only local sections, their transition relations and coefficients, before construction of a global line isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 01N2 (lemma-base-change-map-proj), 01NQ (lemma-relative-proj-base-change), 01NR (lemma-glue-relative-proj-twists), 01OB (definition-projective-bundle): affine degree-one frames, transition fractions, and quotient normalization

proof.text: Apply the degree-two cross relation for the two normalized quotient morphisms q and q prime. Both target line sheaves are invertible: the first is the pullback of D.line, identified with the section-normalized tensor pullback by the unique comparison of left adjoints. Both morphisms are epimorphisms because tensor pullback is a left adjoint and the composition comparisons and equality transport are isomorphisms.

Locally choose free generators of P and Q. Local surjectivity of q gives a section m whose image is the first generator; after shrinking, local surjectivity of q prime gives n whose image under q prime is a generator of Q. Write q(n)=c q(m). Cancel the free first factor in the cross tensor relation to get q prime(n)=c q prime(m). Writing q prime(m)=a q prime(n) gives ca=1 by freeness, so a is a unit and q prime(m) is also a free generator. Choose such a common lifted frame at each point; this produces an index type in the scheme universe and an open cover.

On any subopen of one chart, express q(n) uniquely as c times the first frame. The cross tensor relation with the chosen lift m and cancellation of its free q image imply q prime(n)=c times the second frame. To check an overlap, apply this to the restricted lift of the other chart, obtaining s_j=d s_i and t_j=d t_i. A relation a s_i=c s_j gives a=cd by freeness, hence a t_i=c t_j. These arguments commute with restriction and include empty opens.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01N2, 01NQ, 01NR and 01OB. The geometric generator cross relation is isolated; the atlas is proved by local lifting of epimorphisms and cancellation with free tensor factors, with coefficient extension supplied by the proved affine tensor-section comparison.

theorem exists_normalized_pullback_frame_atlas
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ S) (E : S.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    [((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E).IsQuasicoherent]
    (D : ProjectiveBundleQuotientGeometry.TautologicalQuotient E)
    (D' : ProjectiveBundleQuotientGeometry.TautologicalQuotient
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E))
    (b : Scheme.GradedAlgebraData.PullbackData g (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E)
      (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E)))
    (hb : ∀ (U : S.affineOpens) (W : X.affineOpens) (h : W.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
      (m : E.val.obj (op U.1)),
      b.map h (SymmetricAlgebra.ι Γ(S, U.1) _ m) =
        SymmetricAlgebra.ι Γ(X, W.1) _
          (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackSection g E U.1 m)))
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
        (b.relProjComparison ≫ (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom)).obj E =
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
        ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E)).relProjHom ≫ g)).obj E) :
    let T := (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E)).relProj
    let M := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
      (b.relProjComparison ≫ (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom)).obj E
    let P := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback b.relProjComparison).obj D.line
    let q : M ⟶ P :=
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackSectionComp b.relProjComparison
        (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom).hom.app E ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback b.relProjComparison).map D.quotient
    let q' : M ⟶ D'.line := (eqToIso e).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackSectionComp
        (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E)).relProjHom g).hom.app E ≫ D'.quotient
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (U : ι → T.Opens) (s : ∀ i, Γ(P, U i))
      (t : ∀ i, Γ(D'.line, U i)),
      (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤ ∧ (∀ i, Scheme.Modules.IsFreeGenerator (s i)) ∧
      (∀ i, Scheme.Modules.IsFreeGenerator (t i)) ∧
      (∀ i j (V : T.Opens) (hi : V ≤ U i) (hj : V ≤ U j) (a c : Γ(T, V)),
        a • P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hi).op (s i) =
          c • P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hj).op (s j) →
        a • D'.line.presheaf.map (homOfLE hi).op (t i) =
          c • D'.line.presheaf.map (homOfLE hj).op (t j)) ∧
      ∀ i (V : T.Opens) (hi : V ≤ U i) (m : Γ(M, V)),
        ∃ c : Γ(T, V),
          q.app V m = c • P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hi).op (s i) ∧
          q'.app V m = c • D'.line.presheaf.map (homOfLE hi).op (t i)
